title: docs(003): list rahi and lead with the repositories you already have
body:
> **Hold: do not merge until statecraft.ing publishes its rahi listing.** Decision D-2 (PROF-01) adds rahi to this page and to the site in the same publication window. On 2026-09-13 statecraft.ing's PR 12 is open, and no site change listing rahi is published.

## Summary

The last two landing steps of spec 003, on top of the corrections merged in #2.

- **Roster (6.1, D-2).** rahi joins the page under "The chassis". Its entry has:
  - a paragraph of what it supplies;
  - "Nothing else on this page requires it";
  - **Implemented:** its specs 010 to 034;
  - **Released:** not yet.

  "The chassis" joins the Apache-2.0 line of the license section. hqgit stays off the page.
- **Lead (6.4, D-1).** G-03 is now recorded: statecraft's PR 76 merged spec 014 as approved at `f3d001c`, with section 4 as the thesis. So:
  - the heading becomes "Governed delivery for the repositories you already have";
  - the tagline adds "Local use needs no account; a hosted team layer is planned.";
  - rahi's entry names it as the planned substrate for Statecraft's hosted service.

The lead travels with the roster, because the substrate sentence appends to rahi's entry, and D-1 lands both in one change. The spec records that as a dated decision in section 13.

With this change every landing step is in the tree, so 003 flips to `implementation: complete` here.

Left for a successor spec: the two-plane diagram and "The shape of the family" still describe stamping, which G-03 takes out of the offer. Changing them amends 001, which is not 003's to do.

## Evidence

- **rahi:** specs 010 to 034 are `implementation: complete` on its default branch. It has no release or tag, no crate on crates.io, and an Apache-2.0 license. Independently re-checked on 2026-09-13.
- **G-03:** statecraft `f3d001c`, spec 014 `status: approved`. Section 4 says: "Existing repositories come first. Governed delivery works locally ... without a hosted account. The first hosted layer is team approvals, evidence retention and policy, served from a Rahi cell."

## Testing

- The gate as `AGENTS.md` lists it, all exit 0: `compile`, `index`, `lint --fail-on-warn`, `check --fail-on-unresolved --fail-on-warn` (both trees fresh), `index coverage`, and `couple --base origin/main --head HEAD`.
- `spec-spine verify 001`: passed, 14 commands. `spec-spine verify 003`: passed, 38 commands.
- The page on `main` fails 003 at the new lead check. Nineteen single-fault mutants each fail 003 at their guard, including:
  - the old heading restored;
  - the no-account sentence dropped;
  - rahi without its substrate sentence;
  - rahi without its disclaimer.

title: docs(003): the front door states what is implemented, released and hosted
body:
## Summary

The corrections step of spec 003 on `profile/README.md`, the org front door.

- Each project entry now states **Implemented**, **Released** and **Hosted** as separate facts, citing spec ids, registries and releases. No entry carries a single availability verdict.
- A **Start here** block gives a first adoption path that needs no account or hosted service: `cargo install spec-spine-cli`, then `spec-spine init`.
- The license section names every license that ships, including MPL-2.0 for the three `@statecrafting/toolchain-<platform>` packages, and says what each requires of a redistributor rather than what it prevents. The `## Why these licenses` heading is unchanged.
- enrahitu leads with the membership platform, with its chassis history second.
- Three overclaims are withdrawn: "signed by code" (`statecraft-cli` receipts are unsigned), a coupling gate in every repository (three primitives run none), and a CLI release that carries the local engine (v0.1.0 predates it).

The spec records the owner's decisions PROF-01 to PROF-04 in section 8, and is ratified in this branch. The superseding `extends` edge on 001's `profile/README.md` is the approved instrument (D-5); spec 001 is not edited.

Not in this PR, by decision:

- **rahi's entry** is prepared separately and publishes only alongside statecraft.ing's rahi listing (D-2).
- **The lead** waits until G-03 is on statecraft's default branch (D-1).
- **hqgit** stays off the page (D-2).

003 therefore stays `implementation: in-progress`.

## Evidence behind new claims

- **enrahitu image (C-1):** an anonymous pull of `ghcr.io/statecrafting/enrahitu` was refused (token 401, manifest 403), while the same requests against a known public image succeeded. The page makes no public-availability claim.
- **Start here path:** spec-spine 0.18.0 was installed from crates.io, npm and PyPI into scratch space. With each binary, `init`, `compile`, `index` and `lint` exited 0. `couple` exited 1 on a change to a claimed file without a spec edit, and 0 with one. These were not clean-machine installs: Rust, Node and Python were already present.
- Every cited revision was re-read against GitHub on 2026-09-12. The spec's section 10 lists the source for each claim.
- Before this PR, every page claim was re-checked independently against its source. One sentence was false: two primitives were described as missing from crates.io, but they ship under per-crate names. The owner approved an erratum to 003 section 4.7, which also narrows attest-ledger's signing to its genesis anchor. A new verification line refuses the false sentence.

## Testing

- The gate as `AGENTS.md` lists it, all exit 0:
  - `compile`, `index`
  - `lint --fail-on-warn`
  - `check --fail-on-unresolved --fail-on-warn` (both trees fresh)
  - `index coverage`
  - `couple --base origin/main --head HEAD`
- `spec-spine verify 001`: passed, 14 commands. `spec-spine verify 003`: passed, 34 commands.
- The live page fails 003 at its first check. Sixteen single-fault mutants of the proposed pages each fail 003 at the command that guards the fault. Renaming the license heading also fails 001.
- The page was rendered locally with a GFM parser and every link and badge target checked. GitHub's own rendering is checked on this branch.

title: feat(000,001,002): the front door is governed by the spine it advertises
body:
## Summary

Adopts spec-spine in the repository that renders github.com/statecrafting, so
the org profile is held to the argument it makes. Three specs claim every
tracked path: `000-bootstrap` the substrate (config, standards, the four
standing agent rules), `001-the-profile-is-the-org-front-door` the rendered
surfaces, `002-the-harness-is-governed-like-the-work` the agent harness.

The harness being claimed is the point of 002: widening a permission,
dropping a hook or rewriting the gate list is now refused as `C-001` instead
of landing quietly, and every harness file is folded into the index's
global-inputs hash so such an edit stales the whole ledger until it is
regenerated and committed.

The kit ships as-is (10 skills, 4 agents, hooks on all four events, the
composite `Makefile`, this workflow), with `shepherd/SKILL.md` taken from
spec 082 so a CRITICAL check consumes no remediation round.

Two deliberate departures from the kit defaults, both recorded in 002 3.6
rather than left as silent local edits:

- `check` runs `--fail-on-unresolved --fail-on-warn`. The kit leaves this off
  because a corpus that ratifies before it builds carries unresolved units
  mid-flight (spec 050). This corpus has nothing to build, so there is no such
  window.
- `index coverage` runs unflagged, and `[coupling] require_ownership` is off to
  match. The ownership ratchet walks source files under a discovered package,
  and there is no manifest here to discover one from, so `--fail-on-untraced`
  exits 1 having verified nothing (spec 080). What binds the paths here is
  C-001.

## Testing

The gate as `AGENTS.md` "Working the backlog" lists it, all green on this head:

```
spec-spine lint --fail-on-warn                      0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 info
spec-spine check --fail-on-unresolved --fail-on-warn  spec-registry: fresh, codebase-index: fresh
spec-spine index coverage                           no source files under any discovered package
spec-spine couple --base origin/main --head HEAD    OK: 36 path(s) checked, no drift
```

Each spec's `## Verification` block through `spec-spine verify`:

```
000-bootstrap:                              passed (13 command(s))
001-the-profile-is-the-org-front-door:      passed (14 command(s))
002-the-harness-is-governed-like-the-work:  passed (40 command(s))
```

000's acceptance executes the C-001 refusal rather than asserting it, and
002's does the same for the harness: `.claude/settings.json` alone is refused,
`.claude/settings.json` together with its spec passes. 002 also extracts the
verb list from the `Makefile` `gate` recipe and from the pull-request CI step
and `diff`s them, so the two copies of the chain cannot drift.

Derived shards recompute byte-identically across two runs; `build-meta.json`
is gitignored and not staged. `make test build fmt clippy` are clean no-ops on
the manifest probe.
